Upstream versions and sources

AndroidLibV2rayLite v5.54.2
https://github.com/2dust/AndroidLibV2rayLite/releases/tag/v5.54.2
The AAR is repackaged to retain arm64-v8a only and remove the AAR-bundled geo databases (v13 separately bundles the pinned routing data below). No Java or native code is changed.

V2Ray core v5.54.2
https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/releases/tag/v5.54.2

BadVPN tun2socks binary is from v2rayNG 1.9.46 arm64-v8a release:
https://github.com/2dust/v2rayNG/releases/tag/1.9.46
https://github.com/XTLS/badvpn
https://github.com/shadowsocks/libancillary
The Android tunnel lifecycle and FD relay integration is adapted from v2rayNG under GPL-3.0.

Native icon design: original repo-native Android VectorDrawable, matching SVG in design/.
